model: paired empirical calibration request table, retain session and image identities
quantile_definition: ascending order statistic at ceil(p*n), one-based
acceptance_rule: all three metrics for both CPU profiles must meet their frozen tolerances
scope: service-distribution calibration only; does not certify queue execution, policy performance, network simulation, or deployment
on_failure: archive errors and stop before test; do not tune thresholds or use test measurements to choose a model
